items.quote: They spent the first two weeks understanding how our team actually works before writing a line of code. The voice agent they built now handles the majority of our first-contact calls, and the handover to a human is seamless enough that customers rarely notice the transition.
items.name: Marta Ellison

items.quote: We had automation scattered across four tools and nobody could say what ran where. They consolidated it into one orchestrated system with proper monitoring. When something fails now, we get an alert and a runbook instead of a customer complaint.
items.name: Daniel Okafor

items.quote: The thing that stood out was how carefully they scoped where AI belonged. Half the process ended up as plain deterministic logic, which is cheaper and easier to audit. That honesty saved us money and made the system something our compliance team could sign off on.
items.name: Priya Raghunathan

items.quote: The handover was the best I have experienced. Architecture notes, diagrams, a walkthrough for each of our engineers. Six months on, our own team is extending the platform without needing to call them.
items.name: Alex Novak
